get_config: get a training config object by passing model_config_name, sweep_index, and dataset_name as a comma-separated string
sym_metric_hgn_plus_plus_sweep: get the HGN++ model config and ELBO beta sweep variations for the SyMetric paper experiments
sym_metric_hgn_sweep: get the original HGN paper model config with no sweep variations for the SyMetric paper
benchmark_hgn_overlap_sweep: get the HGN benchmark sweep config with ELBO beta and latent training type variations
benchmark_lgn_sweep: get the LGN benchmark sweep config with matrix-dependent quadratic kinetic function and ELBO beta variations
